title: The Torrent Master's Companion
summary: A companion for the water-aligned past the courses that adds the crashing torrent strike and a rushing guard that holds through a long exchange.

title: A Treatise on the Heavy Flood
summary: A treatise on strikes and presses that bring the whole weight of a flood to one point and drown a defence in it.

title: The Breaker Beyond the Body
summary: Teaches how water qi spread round the body as a living field breaks over attackers like surf and softens what reaches the skin.

title: The Reviving Cascade Course
summary: A course in the falling cascade of water qi that heals and cleanses the wounded and can call back a person at the edge of death.

title: Treatise of the Twin Waters
summary: Teaches paired currents of qi run down two tracks so one hand binds the guard while the other lands the blow.

title: The Hawk and Azure Water Canon
summary: A canon of plunging strikes dropped from above like a hawk into water with an azure veil of qi that follows the dive.

title: Manual of the Returning Flow
summary: A manual of flows that run out and return to the hand carrying the opponent's own force back to the sender with interest.

title: The Rain-Sworn Water Reckoning
summary: A reckoning by which a rain-sworn student calls falling rain into the strike and the guard and answers the wind with it.

title: Manual of the Bearing Tide
summary: A manual of taking a bearing on the opponent and pressing a tide of qi along it without turning aside.

title: The Oath of the Open Flow
summary: A manual of the sworn open flow that hides behind no cover and fills the field with held water qi and a promise to the wounded.
